hero.title: Create professional training programs in minutes
hero.subtitle: The tool trainers need to design, organize, and deliver personalized routines to their clients.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Manage your athlete database centrally. All in one place.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Design personalized routines by dragging exercises from our smart database.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Generate high-quality PDFs with your own branding and send them directly to your clients.

features.title: High performance tools
features.subtitle: Everything you need to scale your personal training business.
features.feat1Desc: Create and reuse exercises with video links. Don't waste time explaining technique over and over again.
features.feat2Desc: Organize by days with granular sets, reps, intensity, and active rest periods.
features.feat3Desc: Export with your own logo and colors. Maintain an elite corporate image.
features.feat4Desc: Access your plans from your phone while at the gym, or from your desk for deep planning sessions.
